verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a GitLab sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. The interactive API tool sends live requests to GitLab. Generic CI 'build and test' statements, self-managed Docker/Linux installs (a user-side workaround), and Allow/Ask/Deny agent tool policies (an adjacent control) do not amount to sandboxed testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
